titulo.estudio: Un article de presse : Repérer les informations
titulo.alumno: A press article: Finding the details

intro: Pick out the thesis, the data and the quoted voices in a current-affairs press article. Read the French first; open the translation whenever you want to check your understanding.

texto: Pick out the thesis, the data and the quoted voices in a current-affairs press article. Tell apart claims, evidence and reservations; attribute each piece of data to its source before drawing a conclusion.
Watch out: an attention-grabbing headline (accrocheur) does not replace the thesis; attribute figures and opinions to whoever states them. In this passage, «article» means «article».

frases.estudio: L'article présente la baisse de fréquentation des centres-villes comme un phénomène récent, mais souligne que les chiffres varient selon les quartiers.
frases.alumno: The article presents the drop in visits to city centres as a recent phenomenon, but points out that the figures vary according to the neighbourhood.

frases.estudio: Une enquête menée auprès de 1 200 commerçants associe ce recul à la hausse des loyers et à l'évolution des habitudes d'achat.
frases.alumno: A survey of 1,200 shopkeepers links this decline to rising rents and changes in shopping habits.
